results.title: Patakka Guddiyan
results.overview: Roohi, a simple girl, is the complete opposite of her twin sister Mahi, who is sharp, daring, and mischievous. As the story progresses, layers of suspense and drama unfold.

results.title: Brussels, Here We Come
results.overview: On election day, two friends who have escaped from a psychiatric hospital hijack an airplane—believing they are filming a documentary—and inadvertently plunge Turkey into an unexpected state of chaos. As commentators in a television studio attempt to make sense of the situation during a live broadcast, what begins as a simple hijacking is quickly transformed into a political crisis. Meanwhile, following the elopement of a trans individual and a local youth, the neighborhood residents gather at a coffeehouse. Incited by fear, anger, and prejudice, the polarized community finds itself drawn into an internal reckoning. Moving between the airplane, the television studio, and the coffeehouse, the film explores how reality can be distorted within the span of a single day, and how an absurd event can escalate into a national panic.

results.title: Mothballs
results.overview: Something is bugging Brian Berger, and all of his work obligations certainly aren’t helping.

results.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
results.overview: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

results.title: Ephemeral: part 1
results.overview: On the last day of sixth grade, a boy walks one final time through the hallways, classrooms, and the places where he grew up alongside his friends. What seems like an ordinary day gradually turns into a quiet farewell. As the hours pass, every conversation, every laugh, and every corner takes on new meaning. For some chapters do not end with a grand event, but with a final moment we only truly understand once it has already gone by. *Ephemeral* is a story about childhood, the passage of time, and those everyday moments that—without warning—become lifelong memories.

results.title: Origin Story
results.overview: Sofia (Valentina Herszage), a 20-year-old Brazilian actress, arrives at a casting audition for an American film that quickly departs from the familiar.  ORIGIN STORY explores identity, performance, and the enduring influence of the American gaze upon Latin American culture.

results.title: Enemy Of The Smuggler
results.overview: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

results.title: Pneumothorax
results.overview: After a fortune-teller predicts her downfall, Aurora, a rising actress, commits a crime in an attempt to prevent it from happening. As she tries to justify her actions, Aurora spirals into guilt and paranoia.

results.title: Woman Who Sold Her Shadow
results.overview: Yuko Kawai works at an advertising agency in Tokyo, but her ordinary life leaves her anxious about the future. As she nears her 28th birthday, a fortune-teller warns that her next yes-or-no answer could change her fate. Soon, a mysterious man offers to grant her wishes for a year in exchange for her shadow. When success and good fortune begin to arrive, Yuko must ask whether getting everything she wanted will truly make her happy.

results.title: Never Feed a Hungry Witch
results.overview: A witch comes to her best friend for help after eating too many children!

results.title: Philly Pretzels
results.overview: JUSTIN CROWELL | UNITED STATES | 2026 | 10 MIN | ENGLISH  Barry, a street-side soft pretzel salesman in South Philly, has an unexpected interaction with brash 19-year-old Brianna after a fight with her boyfriend leaves her stranded.  Cast: Adam Shapiro, Abigail Donaghy

results.title: Thousands of Meters, Hundreds of Hours
results.overview: Through interviews with women who have been trained in the craft of making traditional Lepoglava lace we learn about this symbol's role in the creation of Lepoglava's identity and how it connects local women across time and space.

results.title: The Canvas
results.overview: In an isolated house, a father and his son discover a painting that seems disturbingly alive. When their darkest nightmares begin bleeding into reality, a sinister presence emerges from the canvas, feeding on buried trauma and forgotten memories.

results.title: living
results.overview: A short documentary set in a chicken slaughterhouse, where, amidst the filth, stench, decaying remains of animal carcasses and swarms of insects, a cat and her kittens manage to survive. In a place so deeply marked by human indifference to the death of other creatures, they paradoxically provide at least a hint of the unyielding desire to play, explore, or simply to live.

results.title: On The Line
results.overview: When a teenage boy (Shylo Molina) hangs up on a suicide prevention counselor, (Rosa Salazar) she risks everything to find him. Stealing her boss's car, she sets off on an extraordinary journey that becomes a funny, bittersweet road trip between two strangers who were, only hours earlier, just voices on the line.  Along the way, it becomes clear which one them needs saving.
